properties.name: corpus
properties.purpose:
CORPUS — a folder of documents becomes one design in a single batched handshake. The scale sibling of capture-intent.

DISTINCT FROM cap:corpus-ingest, chg:bl186-folder-driver, epoch:bl186-folder-driver — read and judged different in KIND. Those are the capability or requirement this module serves; this is the module itself. A part and the thing it is for are not the same node, and collapsing them would leave the design unable to say which of the two moved.
